bullets.text: Russian DDoS Attacks Escalate - **NCSC** warns UK critical infrastructure is under persistent threat from Russian hacktivists.
LilaConnect's Rapid Migration - **LilaConnect** successfully migrated to **gaiia** in just 16 weeks, enhancing customer experience.
AI Chatbots Revolutionize Support - Telecoms are shifting from basic chatbots to AI-driven systems for better customer interactions.
Blue Origin's 6 Tbps Network - **Blue Origin** announces **TeraWave**, a space network promising high-speed connectivity globally.
Open Cosmos Launches Satellites - **Open Cosmos** successfully launched its first satellites for a new LEO telecom constellation.
AI for Compliance in Telecom - **e&** and **IBM** partner to deploy AI for governance and compliance in telecom operations.
Wi-Fi 7's Breakout Year - **Cisco** predicts 2026 will be pivotal for widespread **Wi-Fi 7** adoption.
Semantic Layers Enhance Analytics - Telecoms are using semantic layers to simplify data interactions and improve insights.
Telenor Exits Thailand - **Telenor** sells its stake in **True Corporation** for $3.9 billion, reducing its Asian footprint.
Liberty Global Eyes Three Ireland - **Liberty Global** in talks to acquire **Three Ireland** for up to €1.5 billion.
